Hi Alice — appreciated the session. I've drafted the checklist below as a starting point; David / Ben and I will validate specifics for MedSys and annotate the XLS. I've also attached a lightweight template for the connectivity checklist.

Redwood minimal connectivity + onboarding checkpoints (pilot):
- Egress & allowlist: three static egress IPs for token exchange, model fetch, and telemetry (we'll provide pool).
- DNS: internal DNS entries for service discovery (recommend CNAMEs pointing to private IPs or AWS PrivateLink endpoint).
- Firewall: allow outbound HTTPS (443), persistent SSH from a managed bastion (port 22, restricted CIDR), and ephemeral ports for worker heartbeats (TCP 1024-65535) as needed by your CNI.
- Peering/PrivateLink: If you want fully private traffic, configure VPC peering or PrivateLink. We'll share the required prefixes.
- NAT / egress routing: ensure NAT gateway for worker subnets if using public egress; if you want static egress, route via an outbound proxy or dedicated egress NAT.
- KMS/HSM: support for external CloudHSM — we need a service account and key access policy for envelope decryption; prefer a cross-account KMS key or a dedicated HSM client account.
- Service accounts: create a read-only service account for image pulls + a runtime identity for model retrieval with limited scope.
- Certificates: mutual TLS for control-plane connections (we'll provide CA fingerprints).
- Time sync & logging: enable NTP/Chrony and forward audit logs to your SIEM (we recommend 30d retention minimum for pilot).
- Smoke tests: simple text-generation query, model artifact checksum verification, KV cache warmup, and latency test at target sequence lengths.

Next steps / owners:
- Ben: I'll ask you to own the formal checklist file and confirm the egress IPs and PrivateLink options.
- David: will coordinate KMS policy and runtime identity details with your security team.
- Alice: share final dates for the validation window and any procurement constraints.

I attached: connectivity-checklist-template.xlsx and a short KMS diagram. If the Nov 23 window is firm, we should lock in a short preflight call Nov 19 to agree on the smoke test runbook.

Cheers,
Dylan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
